alternatives.quote: With Amazon SQS event source mappings, Lambda polls the queue and invokes your function synchronously with an event. Each event can contain a batch of multiple messages from the queue. Lambda receives these events one batch at a time, and invokes your function once for each batch. When your function successfully processes a batch, Lambda deletes its messages from the queue.
alternatives.title: Using Lambda with Amazon SQS
